def emptyBlockIdSet : RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b) := RBMap.empty

def emptyCAS (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := {
  storage := RBMap.empty,
  contentIndex := RBMap.empty,
  affinityMap := RBMap.empty,
  totalCapacity := cap,
  usedCapacity := 0
}

  pendingTasks := RBMap.empty,
  activeTasks := RBMap.empty,
  completedTasks := #[],

  flowGraph := RBMap.empty,

  storage := emptyCAS cap,
  scheduler := emptyScheduler,
  flowAnalyzer := emptyAnalyzer,
  cores := RBMap.empty,
  cycleCount := 0,
  migrationCount := 0,

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=
  let dataArray := data.toList
  let v := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < dataArray.length then dataArray.get! i else 0) CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
  v

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let chBytes := ch.toList
  let tsBytes := (ts.toNat.toDigits 10).map (fun d => d.toUInt8) -- Mock timestamp serialization
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes
  let combinedVec := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < combined.length then combined.get! i else 0) BLOCK_ID_SIZE
  combinedVec

def MemoryBlock.init (id : BlockId) (ch : ContentHash) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock :=
  {
    blockId := id,
    contentHash := ch,
    data := data,
    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,
    accessCount := 1,
    lastAccessTime := time,
    entangledBlocks := RBMap.empty
  }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { coreId := id, state := CoreState.idle, cyclesActive := 0, cyclesIdle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (core : ProcessingCore) (isActive : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if isActive then
    { core with cyclesActive := core.cyclesActive + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { core with cyclesIdle := core.cyclesIdle + 1, state := if core.state = CoreState.powerGated then CoreState.powerGated else CoreState.idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (core : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := core.cyclesActive + core.cyclesIdle
  if total = 0 then 0.0 else (core.cyclesActive : Float) / (total : Float)

def CASInvariants (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    (∀ (eid : BlockId), blk.entangledBlocks.contains eid → cas.storage.contains eid)) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

theorem emptyCAS_inv (cap : Nat) : CASInvariants (emptyCAS cap) := by
  unfold emptyCAS CASInvariants
  constructor
  . simp
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match idSet.toList.findSome? (fun id => cas.storage.find id) with
    | some blk =>
      let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert blk.blockId updatedBlk
      let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
      Except.ok (newCAS, blk.blockId)
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let ts := time
        let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (idSet.insert bid ())
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
       Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let ts := time
      let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (RBMap.empty.insert bid ())
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bid)

theorem CAS.store_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) (t : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data pref t with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  split
  . next => 
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_find
      split
      . next h_existing =>
        constructor <;> try trivial
        rw [h_inv.1]
      . next h_none =>
        split
        . next => trivial
        . next h_need_evict => trivial
        . next h_ok =>
          cases h_ok
          constructor
          linarith
    . next => trivial
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    . next h_err => trivial
    . next h_need_evict => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      constructor
      linarith

def CAS.retrieve (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | some blk => some blk.data
  | none => none

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  . next h_eq => contradiction h_eq h_ne
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i blk1 blk2
    constructor <;> simp [RBMap.insert]

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => trivial
  . next blk =>
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next oc =>
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_empty
      split <;> try trivial
      simp [RBMap.insert]

def Scheduler.submit (sched : SchedulerState) (prio : Int) (deps : Array BlockId) (est : Nat) (tid : TaskId) : SchedulerState :=
  let task : TaskDescriptor := {
    taskId := tid,
    priority := prio,
    dataDependencies := deps,
    estimatedCycles := est,
    assignedCore := none,
    completionStatus := false,
    startTime := 0,
    endTime := 0
  }
  { sched with pendingTasks := sched.pendingTasks.insert tid task }

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  if h : sched.pendingTasks.isEmpty then none else
    let res := sched.pendingTasks.fold (fun acc tid task =>
      match acc with
      | none => some (tid, task)
      | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
        if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (tid, task) else acc
    ) none
    res

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.findSome? (fun cid ccore => if ccore.state = CoreState.powerGated then none else some (cid, ccore)) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.erase tid
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))

def Scheduler.complete (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) : SchedulerState :=
  match sched.activeTasks.find tid with
  | none => sched
  | some task =>
      let completedTask := { task with completionStatus := true, endTime := time }
      let newActive := sched.activeTasks.erase tid
      let newSched := { sched with activeTasks := newActive, completedTasks := sched.completedTasks.push completedTask }
      newSched

theorem Scheduler.complete_moves_to_completed (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) :
    (Scheduler.complete sched tid time).completedTasks.size = sched.completedTasks.size + (if sched.activeTasks.contains tid then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold Scheduler.complete
  split
  . next => simp
  . next task =>
    simp

def Kernel.executeCycle (k : KernelState) : KernelState :=
  let (sched, scheduledInfo) := Scheduler.schedule k.scheduler k.cores k.storage k.currentTime
  let cores' := k.cores.map (fun cid core =>
      let isActive := match scheduledInfo with
        | some (t, c) => c = cid
        | none => false
      core.tick isActive
    )
  let k' := { k with scheduler := sched, cores := cores', cycleCount := k.cycleCount + 1 }
  k'

theorem Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count (k : KernelState) :
    (Kernel.executeCycle k).cycleCount = k.cycleCount + 1 := by
  unfold Kernel.executeCycle
  simp

def Kernel.addCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.insert id (ProcessingCore.init id) }

theorem Kernel.addCore_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    (Kernel.addCore k id).cores.contains id := by
  unfold Kernel.addCore
  simp [RBMap.insert]

def Kernel.removeCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.erase id }

theorem Kernel.removeCore_not_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    ¬((Kernel.removeCore k id).cores.contains id) := by
  unfold Kernel.removeCore
  simp

def Kernel.allocateMemory (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) : Except String (KernelState × BlockId) :=
  match CAS.store k.storage data prefCore k.currentTime with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (newCAS, bid) =>
      Except.ok ({ k with storage := newCAS }, bid)

theorem Kernel.allocateMemory_increases_storage (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    data.size ≤ k.storage.totalCapacity →
    match Kernel.allocateMemory k data pref with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (k', _) => k'.storage.usedCapacity ≥ k.storage.usedCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cap
  unfold Kernel.allocateMemory
  split <;> try trivial
  rename_i newCAS bid h_store
  unfold CAS.store at h_store
  split at h_store <;> try trivial
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp

def Kernel.readMemory (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  CAS.retrieve k.storage bid

def Kernel.entangleData (k : KernelState) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.entangleBlocks k.storage bid1 bid2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS }

def Kernel.migrateBlock (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.migrateBlock k.storage bid tid with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS, migrationCount := k.migrationCount + 1 }

theorem Kernel.migrateBlock_increases_count (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    k.storage.contains bid →
    match Kernel.migrateBlock k bid tid with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok k' => k'.migrationCount = k.migrationCount + 1
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cont
  unfold Kernel.migrateBlock
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => contradiction h_cont (by simp)
  . next blk =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_new
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next =>
      split <;> try trivial
      . next => trivial
      . next => trivial

end ChaosCore

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=
  let dataArray := data.toList
  let v := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < dataArray.length then dataArray.get! i else 0) CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
  v

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let chBytes := ch.toList
  let tsBytes := (ts.toNat.toDigits 10).map (fun d => d.toUInt8) -- Mock timestamp serialization
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes
  let combinedVec := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < combined.length then combined.get! i else 0) BLOCK_ID_SIZE
  combinedVec

def MemoryBlock.init (id : BlockId) (ch : ContentHash) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock :=
  {
    blockId := id,
    contentHash := ch,
    data := data,
    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,
    accessCount := 1,
    lastAccessTime := time,
    entangledBlocks := RBMap.empty
  }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { coreId := id, state := CoreState.idle, cyclesActive := 0, cyclesIdle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (core : ProcessingCore) (isActive : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if isActive then
    { core with cyclesActive := core.cyclesActive + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { core with cyclesIdle := core.cyclesIdle + 1, state := if core.state = CoreState.powerGated then CoreState.powerGated else CoreState.idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (core : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := core.cyclesActive + core.cyclesIdle
  if total = 0 then 0.0 else (core.cyclesActive : Float) / (total : Float)

def CASInvariants (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    (∀ (eid : BlockId), blk.entangledBlocks.contains eid → cas.storage.contains eid)) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

theorem emptyCAS_inv (cap : Nat) : CASInvariants (emptyCAS cap) := by
  unfold emptyCAS CASInvariants
  constructor
  . simp
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match idSet.toList.findSome? (fun id => cas.storage.find id) with
    | some blk =>
      let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert blk.blockId updatedBlk
      let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
      Except.ok (newCAS, blk.blockId)
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let ts := time
        let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (idSet.insert bid ())
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
       Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let ts := time
      let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (RBMap.empty.insert bid ())
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bid)

theorem CAS.store_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) (t : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data pref t with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  split
  . next => 
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_find
      split
      . next h_existing =>
        constructor <;> try trivial
        rw [h_inv.1]
      . next h_none =>

        . next => trivial
        . next h_need_evict => trivial
        . next h_ok =>

          constructor
          linarith
    . next => trivial
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    . next h_err => trivial
    . next h_need_evict => trivial
    . next h_ok =>

      constructor
      linarith

def CAS.retrieve (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | some blk => some blk.data
  | none => none

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  . next h_eq => contradiction h_eq h_ne
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i blk1 blk2
    constructor <;> simp [RBMap.insert]

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => trivial
  . next blk =>
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next oc =>
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_empty
      split <;> try trivial
      simp [RBMap.insert]

def Scheduler.submit (sched : SchedulerState) (prio : Int) (deps : Array BlockId) (est : Nat) (tid : TaskId) : SchedulerState :=
  let task : TaskDescriptor := {
    taskId := tid,
    priority := prio,
    dataDependencies := deps,
    estimatedCycles := est,
    assignedCore := none,
    completionStatus := false,
    startTime := 0,
    endTime := 0
  }
  { sched with pendingTasks := sched.pendingTasks.insert tid task }

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  if h : sched.pendingTasks.isEmpty then none else
    let res := sched.pendingTasks.fold (fun acc tid task =>
      match acc with
      | none => some (tid, task)
      | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
        if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (tid, task) else acc
    ) none
    res

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.findSome? (fun cid ccore => if ccore.state = CoreState.powerGated then none else some (cid, ccore)) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.erase tid
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))

def Scheduler.complete (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) : SchedulerState :=
  match sched.activeTasks.find tid with
  | none => sched
  | some task =>
      let completedTask := { task with completionStatus := true, endTime := time }
      let newActive := sched.activeTasks.erase tid
      let newSched := { sched with activeTasks := newActive, completedTasks := sched.completedTasks.push completedTask }
      newSched

theorem Scheduler.complete_moves_to_completed (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) :
    (Scheduler.complete sched tid time).completedTasks.size = sched.completedTasks.size + (if sched.activeTasks.contains tid then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold Scheduler.complete
  split
  . next => simp
  . next task =>
    simp

def Kernel.executeCycle (k : KernelState) : KernelState :=
  let (sched, scheduledInfo) := Scheduler.schedule k.scheduler k.cores k.storage k.currentTime
  let cores' := k.cores.map (fun cid core =>
      let isActive := match scheduledInfo with
        | some (t, c) => c = cid
        | none => false
      core.tick isActive
    )
  let k' := { k with scheduler := sched, cores := cores', cycleCount := k.cycleCount + 1 }
  k'

theorem Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count (k : KernelState) :
    (Kernel.executeCycle k).cycleCount = k.cycleCount + 1 := by
  unfold Kernel.executeCycle
  simp

def Kernel.addCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.insert id (ProcessingCore.init id) }

theorem Kernel.addCore_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    (Kernel.addCore k id).cores.contains id := by
  unfold Kernel.addCore
  simp [RBMap.insert]

def Kernel.removeCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.erase id }

theorem Kernel.removeCore_not_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    ¬((Kernel.removeCore k id).cores.contains id) := by
  unfold Kernel.removeCore
  simp

def Kernel.allocateMemory (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) : Except String (KernelState × BlockId) :=
  match CAS.store k.storage data prefCore k.currentTime with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (newCAS, bid) =>
      Except.ok ({ k with storage := newCAS }, bid)

theorem Kernel.allocateMemory_increases_storage (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    data.size ≤ k.storage.totalCapacity →
    match Kernel.allocateMemory k data pref with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (k', _) => k'.storage.usedCapacity ≥ k.storage.usedCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cap
  unfold Kernel.allocateMemory
  split <;> try trivial
  rename_i newCAS bid h_store
  unfold CAS.store at h_store
  split at h_store <;> try trivial
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp

def Kernel.readMemory (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  CAS.retrieve k.storage bid

def Kernel.entangleData (k : KernelState) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.entangleBlocks k.storage bid1 bid2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS }

def Kernel.migrateBlock (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.migrateBlock k.storage bid tid with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS, migrationCount := k.migrationCount + 1 }

theorem Kernel.migrateBlock_increases_count (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    k.storage.contains bid →
    match Kernel.migrateBlock k bid tid with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok k' => k'.migrationCount = k.migrationCount + 1
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cont
  unfold Kernel.migrateBlock
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => contradiction h_cont (by simp)
  . next blk =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_new
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next =>
      split <;> try trivial
      . next => trivial
      . next => trivial

namespace ChaosCore

def BLOCK_ID_SIZE : Nat := 16
def CONTENT_HASH_SIZE : Nat := 16
def SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE : Nat := 32
def DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE : Nat := 1048576
def OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.6
def LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD : Float := 1.3
def LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.7
def BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES : Nat := 100

abbrev BlockId := Vector UInt8 BLOCK_ID_SIZE
abbrev ContentHash := Vector UInt8 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
abbrev TaskId := Vector UInt8 SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE

def vectorCompare {n : Nat} (v1 v2 : Vector UInt8 n) : Ordering :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Ordering :=
    if h : i < n then
      let b1 := v1.get (Fin.mk i h)
      let b2 := v2.get (Fin.mk i h)
      if b1 < b2 then Ordering.lt
      else if b1 > b2 then Ordering.gt
      else loop (i + 1)
    else Ordering.eq
  loop 0

instance : Ord BlockId where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq BlockId where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable BlockId where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

instance : Ord ContentHash where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq ContentHash where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable ContentHash where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

instance : Ord TaskId where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq TaskId where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable TaskId where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

def compareProd {α β} [Ord α] [Ord β] (p1 p2 : α × β) : Ordering :=
  match compare p1.1 p2.2 with
  | .eq => compare p1.2 p2.2
  | ord => ord

inductive MemoryBlockState where
  | free
  | allocated
  | entangled
  | migrating
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

inductive CoreState where
  | idle
  | active
  | powerGated
  | stalled
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int
  coreId : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure MemoryBlock where
  blockId : BlockId
  contentHash : ContentHash
  data : ByteArray
  size : Nat
  state : MemoryBlockState
  affinityCore : Option Nat
  accessCount : Nat
  lastAccessTime : Int
  entangledBlocks : Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)
deriving Inhabited

structure TaskDescriptor where
  taskId : TaskId
  priority : Int
  dataDependencies : Array BlockId
  estimatedCycles : Nat
  assignedCore : Option Nat

  endTime : Int
deriving Inhabited

  state : CoreState
  cyclesActive : Nat
  cyclesIdle : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : Std.RBMap BlockId MemoryBlock (fun a b => compare a b)
  contentIndex : Std.RBMap ContentHash (Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (fun a b => compare a b)
  affinityMap : Std.RBMap Nat (Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (fun a b => compare a b)
  totalCapacity : Nat
  usedCapacity : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure SchedulerState where
  pendingTasks : Std.RBMap TaskId TaskDescriptor (fun a b => compare a b)
  activeTasks : Std.RBMap TaskId TaskDescriptor (fun a b => compare a b)

deriving Inhabited

  flowWeights : Std.RBMap (BlockId × BlockId) Float (fun a b => compareProd a b)
  accessPatterns : Std.RBMap BlockId (Array AccessRecord) (fun a b => compare a b)
deriving Inhabited

structure KernelState where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : SchedulerState
  flowAnalyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore compare
  cycleCount : Nat
  migrationCount : Nat

deriving Inhabited

def emptyBlockIdSet : Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b) := Std.RBMap.empty

def emptyCAS (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := {
  storage := Std.RBMap.empty,
  contentIndex := Std.RBMap.empty,
  affinityMap := Std.RBMap.empty,
  totalCapacity := cap,
  usedCapacity := 0
}

def emptyScheduler : SchedulerState := {
  pendingTasks := Std.RBMap.empty,
  activeTasks := Std.RBMap.empty,
  completedTasks := #[],
  taskCounter := 0
}

def emptyAnalyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer := {
  flowGraph := Std.RBMap.empty,
  flowWeights := Std.RBMap.empty,
  accessPatterns := Std.RBMap.empty
}

def emptyKernel (cap : Nat) : KernelState := {
  storage := emptyCAS cap,
  scheduler := emptyScheduler,
  flowAnalyzer := emptyAnalyzer,
  cores := Std.RBMap.empty,
  cycleCount := 0,
  migrationCount := 0,
  currentTime := 0
}

def djb2Hash (data : ByteArray) : Nat :=
  data.foldl (fun h b => ((h <<< 5) + h + b.toNat) % (2^64 - 1)) 5381

def natToBytes (n : Nat) (len : Nat) : ByteArray :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < len then
      let byte := ((n / (256 ^ i)) % 256).toUInt8
      loop (i + 1) (acc.push byte)
    else acc
  loop 0 ByteArray.empty

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=
  let h := djb2Hash data
  let bytes := natToBytes h CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (v : Vector UInt8 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) : Vector UInt8 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE :=
    match i, v with
    | 0, v => v
    | i+1, v =>
        let byte := if i < bytes.size then bytes.get! i else 0
        loop i (v.set (Fin.mk i (by omega)) byte)
  loop (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - 1) (Vector.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0)

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let tsNat := (ts.toNat + 2147483648) % (2^64)
  let tsBytes := natToBytes tsNat 8
  let chBytes := ch.toList.map (fun b => b)
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes
  ByteArray.mk combined

def MemoryBlock.init (id : BlockId) (ch : ContentHash) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock :=
  {
    blockId := id,
    contentHash := ch,
    data := data,
    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,
    accessCount := 1,
    lastAccessTime := time,
    entangledBlocks := Std.RBMap.empty
  }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { coreId := id, state := CoreState.idle, cyclesActive := 0, cyclesIdle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (core : ProcessingCore) (isActive : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if isActive then
    { core with cyclesActive := core.cyclesActive + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { core with cyclesIdle := core.cyclesIdle + 1, state := if core.state = CoreState.powerGated then CoreState.powerGated else CoreState.idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (core : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := core.cyclesActive + core.cyclesIdle
  if total = 0 then 0.0 else (core.cyclesActive : Float) / (total : Float)

def CASInvariants (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    ∀ (eid : BlockId), blk.entangledBlocks.contains eid → cas.storage.contains eid) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

theorem emptyCAS_inv (cap : Nat) : CASInvariants (emptyCAS cap) := by
  unfold emptyCAS CASInvariants
  constructor
  . simp
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h

def findFirstInIndex (idSet : Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (storage : Std.RBMap BlockId MemoryBlock (fun a b => compare a b)) : Option BlockId :=
  idSet.fold (init := none) (fun acc k _ =>
    match acc with
    | some _ => acc
    | none =>
      if storage.contains k then some k else none
  )

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match findFirstInIndex idSet cas.storage with
    | some bid =>
      match cas.storage.find bid with
      | some blk =>
        let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid updatedBlk
        let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
      | none => Except.ok (cas, bid) -- Should not happen due to findFirst
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let bidBytes := computeBlockId ch time
        let bidVec : BlockId :=
          let rec loop (i : Nat) (v : BlockId) : BlockId :=
            if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then
              let b := if i < bidBytes.size then bidBytes.get! i else 0
              loop (i+1) (v.set (Fin.mk i (by omega)) b)
            else v
          loop 0 (Vector.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
        
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bidVec ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bidVec blk
        let newIdSet := idSet.insert bidVec ()
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch newIdSet
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bidVec ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bidVec)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
       Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let bidBytes := computeBlockId ch time
      let bidVec : BlockId :=
          let rec loop (i : Nat) (v : BlockId) : BlockId :=
            if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then
              let b := if i < bidBytes.size then bidBytes.get! i else 0
              loop (i+1) (v.set (Fin.mk i (by omega)) b)
            else v
          loop 0 (Vector.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bidVec ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bidVec blk
      let newIdSet := Std.RBMap.empty.insert bidVec ()
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch newIdSet
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bidVec ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bidVec)

theorem CAS.store_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) (t : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data pref t with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  generalize h_ch : computeContentHash data = ch
  cases h_eq : cas.contentIndex.find ch <;> try trivial
  case some idSet =>
    generalize h_find : findFirstInIndex idSet cas.storage = h_res
    cases h_res <;> try trivial
    case some bid =>
      cases h_eq2 : cas.storage.find bid <;> try trivial
      case some blk =>
        constructor
        rw [h_inv.1]
      case none =>
        constructor
        rw [h_inv.1]
    case none =>
      unfold findFirstInIndex at h_find
      simp at h_find
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_size h_cap
      constructor
      linarith
  case none =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_size h_cap
    constructor
    linarith

def CAS.retrieve (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | some blk => some blk.data
  | none => none

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  . next h_eq => contradiction h_eq h_ne
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i blk1 blk2
    constructor
    . simp [Std.RBMap.insert]
    . simp [Std.RBMap.insert]

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => trivial
  . next blk =>
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next oc =>
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_empty
      split <;> try trivial
      simp [Std.RBMap.insert]

def Scheduler.submit (sched : SchedulerState) (prio : Int) (deps : Array BlockId) (est : Nat) (tid : TaskId) : SchedulerState :=
  let task : TaskDescriptor := {
    taskId := tid,
    priority := prio,
    dataDependencies := deps,
    estimatedCycles := est,
    assignedCore := none,
    completionStatus := false,
    startTime := 0,
    endTime := 0
  }
  { sched with pendingTasks := sched.pendingTasks.insert tid task }

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  sched.pendingTasks.fold (init := none) (fun acc tid task =>
    match acc with
    | none => some (tid, task)
    | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
      if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (tid, task) else acc
  )

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.fold (init := none) (fun acc cid core =>
          match acc with
          | some r => some r
          | none => if core.state ≠ CoreState.powerGated then some (cid, core) else none
        ) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.erase tid
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))

def Scheduler.complete (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) : SchedulerState :=
  match sched.activeTasks.find tid with
  | none => sched
  | some task =>
      let completedTask := { task with completionStatus := true, endTime := time }
      let newActive := sched.activeTasks.erase tid
      let newSched := { sched with activeTasks := newActive, completedTasks := sched.completedTasks.push completedTask }
      newSched

theorem Scheduler.complete_moves_to_completed (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) :
    (Scheduler.complete sched tid time).completedTasks.size = sched.completedTasks.size + (if sched.activeTasks.contains tid then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold Scheduler.complete
  split
  . next => simp
  . next task =>
    simp [Array.push]

def Kernel.executeCycle (k : KernelState) : KernelState :=
  let (sched, scheduledInfo) := Scheduler.schedule k.scheduler k.cores k.storage k.currentTime
  let cores' := k.cores.fold (init := k.cores) (fun acc cid core =>
      let isActive := match scheduledInfo with
        | some (t, c) => c = cid
        | none => false
      acc.insert cid (core.tick isActive)
    )
  let k' := { k with scheduler := sched, cores := cores', cycleCount := k.cycleCount + 1 }
  k'

theorem Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count (k : KernelState) :
    (Kernel.executeCycle k).cycleCount = k.cycleCount + 1 := by
  unfold Kernel.executeCycle
  simp

def Kernel.addCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.insert id (ProcessingCore.init id) }

theorem Kernel.addCore_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    (Kernel.addCore k id).cores.contains id := by
  unfold Kernel.addCore
  simp [Std.RBMap.contains, Std.RBMap.find]

def Kernel.removeCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.erase id }

theorem Kernel.removeCore_not_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    ¬((Kernel.removeCore k id).cores.contains id) := by
  unfold Kernel.removeCore
  simp [Std.RBMap.contains, Std.RBMap.find, Std.RBMap.erase]

def Kernel.allocateMemory (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) : Except String (KernelState × BlockId) :=
  match CAS.store k.storage data prefCore k.currentTime with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (newCAS, bid) =>
      Except.ok ({ k with storage := newCAS }, bid)

theorem Kernel.allocateMemory_increases_storage (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    data.size ≤ k.storage.totalCapacity →
    match Kernel.allocateMemory k data pref with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (k', _) => k'.storage.usedCapacity ≥ k.storage.usedCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cap
  unfold Kernel.allocateMemory
  split <;> try trivial
  rename_i newCAS bid h_store
  generalize h_ch : computeContentHash data = ch
  cases h_eq : k.storage.contentIndex.find ch <;> try trivial
  case some idSet =>
    generalize h_find : findFirstInIndex idSet k.storage = h_res
    cases h_res <;> try trivial
    case some bid_found =>
      cases h_eq2 : k.storage.find bid_found <;> try trivial
      case some blk =>
        simp
      case none =>
        simp
    case none =>
      unfold findFirstInIndex at h_find
      simp at h_find
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_size h_need
      rename_i h_ok
      cases h_ok
      simp [add_comm, Nat.le_add_right]
  case none =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_size h_need
    rename_i h_ok
    cases h_ok
    simp [add_comm, Nat.le_add_right]

def Kernel.readMemory (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  CAS.retrieve k.storage bid

def Kernel.entangleData (k : KernelState) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.entangleBlocks k.storage bid1 bid2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS }

def Kernel.migrateBlock (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.migrateBlock k.storage bid tid with

namespace ChaosCore

def BLOCK_ID_SIZE : Nat := 16
def CONTENT_HASH_SIZE : Nat := 16
def SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE : Nat := 32
def DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE : Nat := 1048576
def OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.6
def LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD : Float := 1.3
def LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.7
def BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES : Nat := 100

abbrev BlockId := Vector UInt8 BLOCK_ID_SIZE
abbrev ContentHash := Vector UInt8 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
abbrev TaskId := Vector UInt8 SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE

def vectorCompare {n : Nat} (v1 v2 : Vector UInt8 n) : Ordering :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Ordering :=
    if h : i < n then
      let b1 := v1.get (Fin.mk i h)
      let b2 := v2.get (Fin.mk i h)
      if b1 < b2 then Ordering.lt
      else if b1 > b2 then Ordering.gt
      else loop (i + 1)
    else Ordering.eq
  loop 0

instance : Ord BlockId where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq BlockId where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable BlockId where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

instance : Ord ContentHash where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq ContentHash where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable ContentHash where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

instance : Ord TaskId where
  compare := vectorCompare

instance : BEq TaskId where
  beq a b := vectorCompare a b = .eq

instance : Hashable TaskId where
  hash v := v.foldl (fun acc b => (acc * 31 + b.toNat) % 2147483647) 0

def compareProd {α β} [Ord α] [Ord β] (p1 p2 : α × β) : Ordering :=
  match compare p1.1 p2.1 with
  | .eq => compare p1.2 p2.2
  | ord => ord

inductive MemoryBlockState where
  | free
  | allocated
  | entangled
  | migrating
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

inductive CoreState where
  | idle
  | active
  | powerGated
  | stalled
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int

deriving Inhabited

  contentHash : ContentHash
  data : ByteArray

  state : MemoryBlockState
  affinityCore : Option Nat

  cyclesIdle : Nat
deriving Inhabited

  contentIndex : Std.RBMap ContentHash (Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (fun a b => compare a b)
  affinityMap : Std.RBMap Nat (Std.RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) Nat.compare

  contentIndex := Std.RBMap.empty,
  affinityMap := Std.RBMap.empty,

  flowAnalyzer := emptyAnalyzer,

  cycleCount := 0,
  migrationCount := 0,
  currentTime := 0

def djb2Hash (data : ByteArray) : Nat :=
  data.foldl (fun h b => ((h <<< 5) + h + b.toNat) % (2^64 - 1)) 5381

def natToBytes (n : Nat) (len : Nat) : ByteArray :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if h : i < len then
      let pow := 256 ^ i
      let byte := ((n / pow) % 256).toUInt8
      loop (i + 1) (acc.push byte)
    else acc

  Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin BLOCK_ID_SIZE =>
    let idx := i.val
    if h : idx < ba.size then ba.get idx else 0

  let h := djb2Hash data
  let bytes := natToBytes h CONTENT_HASH_SIZE

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let tsNat := (ts.toNat + 2147483648) % (2^64)

  let chBytes := Array.mk (ch.toList)
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes.toArray

    contentHash := ch,

    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,

def vectorCompare {n : Nat} (v1 v2 : Vector UInt8 n) : Ordering :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Ordering :=
    if h : i < n then
      let b1 := v1.get ⟨i, h⟩
      let b2 := v2.get ⟨i, h⟩
      if b1 < b2 then Ordering.lt
      else if b1 > b2 then Ordering.gt
      else loop (i + 1)
    else Ordering.eq
  loop 0

    case inl h1 =>
      have h2 : i + 1 ≤ len := by omega
      have h3 : (acc.push ((n / 256 ^ i) % 256).toUInt8).size = acc.size + 1 := by
        simp

      simp [this]
  simp [aux 0 ByteArray.empty (by omega)]

def byteArrayToVector (ba : ByteArray) (n : Nat) : Vector UInt8 n :=
  Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin n =>
    if h : i.val < ba.size then ba.get ⟨i.val, h⟩ else 0
  )

theorem byteArrayToVector_get_in_bounds (ba : ByteArray) (n : Nat) (i : Fin n) (h : i.val < ba.size) :
    (byteArrayToVector ba n).get i = ba.get ⟨i.val, h⟩ := by
  simp [byteArrayToVector]
  split
  case inl h1 => rfl
  case inr h2 => contradiction
  done

theorem byteArrayToVector_get_out_bounds (ba : ByteArray) (n : Nat) (i : Fin n) (h : ¬(i.val < ba.size)) :
    (byteArrayToVector ba n).get i = 0 := by
  simp [byteArrayToVector]
  split
  case inl h1 => contradiction
  case inr h2 => rfl
  done

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let tsNat := (ts.toNat + 2147483648) % (2^64)
  let tsBytes := natToBytes tsNat 8
  let chArray := ch.toArray
  let combined := chArray ++ tsBytes.toArray
  byteArrayToVector (ByteArray.mk combined) BLOCK_ID_SIZE

  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →

  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match findFirstInIndex idSet cas.storage with
    | some bid =>
      match cas.storage.find bid with
      | some blk =>
        let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid updatedBlk
        let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
      | none =>
        if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "OutOfMemory"
        else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "NeedEviction"
        else
          let bid := computeBlockId ch time
          let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
          let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
          let newIdSet := idSet.insert bid ()
          let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch newIdSet
          let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
            | none => cas.affinityMap
            | some c =>
               let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
               cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
          let newCAS := {
            storage := newStorage,
            contentIndex := newContentIndex,
            affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
            totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
            usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
          }
          Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let bid := computeBlockId ch time
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
        let newIdSet := Std.RBMap.empty.insert bid ()
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch newIdSet
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let bid := computeBlockId ch time
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
      let newIdSet := Std.RBMap.empty.insert bid ()
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch newIdSet
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bid)

theorem CAS.store_preserves_capacity_invariant (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data prefCore time with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  split
  case h_1 =>
    split
    case h_2 =>

        case inr h_not_oom =>

          case inl h_need => simp
          case inr h_ok =>
            simp
            linarith [h_inv.1, Nat.le_add_left data.size cas.usedCapacity]
    case h_5 =>
      split
      case inl h_oom => simp
      case inr h_not_oom =>
        split
        case inl h_need => simp
        case inr h_ok =>
          simp
          linarith [h_inv.1, Nat.le_add_left data.size cas.usedCapacity]
  case h_6 =>
    split
    case inl h_oom => simp
    case inr h_not_oom =>
      split
      case inl h_need => simp
      case inr h_ok =>
        simp
        linarith [h_inv.1, Nat.le_add_left data.size cas.usedCapacity]

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  case inl h_eq => contradiction
  case inr h_neq =>
    cases cas.storage.find bid1 with
    | none => simp
    | some blk1 =>
      cases cas.storage.find bid2 with
      | none => simp
      | some blk2 =>
        simp
        constructor
        · simp [Std.RBMap.find_insert]
          split
          case inl h => simp
          case inr h => simp
        · simp [Std.RBMap.find_insert]
          split
          case inl h => simp
          case inr h => simp

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD Std.RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :

    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  cases cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => simp
  | some blk =>
    simp
    cases blk.affinityCore with
    | none =>
      simp [Std.RBMap.find_insert]
      split
      case inl h => simp
      case inr h => simp
    | some c =>
      simp [Std.RBMap.find_insert]
      split
      case inl h => simp
      case inr h => simp

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  sched.pendingTasks.foldl (init := none) (fun acc task =>
    match acc with
    | none => some (task.taskId, task)
    | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
      if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (task.taskId, task) else acc
  )

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.toList.find? (fun (cid, core) => core.state ≠ CoreState.powerGated) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.filter (fun t => t.taskId ≠ tid)
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))
